verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface for operating OCI, such as a console assistant or an NL-driven CLI. The CLI, SDKs, REST APIs and Terraform are all command- or code-driven. The official MCP server (github.com/oracle/mcp) belongs to a separate agent-connectivity story and only enables NL operation through an external AI client. The Select AI mentions describe database SDK and agent features, not operating the platform in natural language.
